newsitem.title: USA: PLM stake raised by Steel Ptns to 9.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: PLM stake raised by Steel Ptns to 9.3 pct.

text.p: Steel Partners LP on Tuesday said it has increased its stake in PLM International Inc to 9.3 percent or 852,100 common shares.
In a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission, the New York based investment partnership said it most recently acquired 308,800 shares between May 12 and July 3 at $5.41 to $5.82 each.
PLM, with headquarters in San Francisco, offers leasing and management services for a broad range of transportation equipment.

In May, Steel Partners said in an SEC filing that it plans to have future discussions with the company about its business operations and ways to enhance stockholder value. The group, at that time, said it may in the future seek to acquire control of the company in a negotiated transaction or otherwise.
